name: Bath (United States)
description: Red upper part charged with a yellow full-rigged ship, over three white and blue wavy stripes for the Kennebec River and Merrymeeting Bay, inspired by the arms of Bath in England.
history: Bath is a city in and county seat of Sagadahoc County, Maine. The flag was adopted on 3 July 2013 (adopted by resolution of the Bath City Council on 3 July 2013, developed by the city's flag committee with Jeremy Hammond, according to Flags of the World).

features.role: wavy stripes of white and blue for the Kennebec River and Merrymeeting Bay
